display_string_changes.before:
Phase D: bounded real-data Q3D T/J GPU profile.

Example (run only after the corrected K8 manifests and real T/Q/P artifacts
are available, along with separate TRAIN/DEV geometry repair evidence and a
geometry-bound ERF phase receipt):

    python scripts/q3d_profile_gpu.py --config /path/to/acdc-k8-v1.json       --stage-artifact T=/path/to/T.json --stage-artifact Q=/path/to/Q.json       --stage-artifact P=/path/to/P.json       --stage-artifact-sha T=<sha256> --stage-artifact-sha Q=<sha256>       --stage-artifact-sha P=<sha256>       --train-source-manifest /path/to/source-train.json       --train-source-manifest-sha256 <sha256> --train-repair-report /path/to/train-repair.json       --train-repair-report-sha256 <sha256>       --dev-source-manifest /path/to/source-dev.json --dev-source-manifest-sha256 <sha256>       --dev-repair-report /path/to/dev-repair.json --dev-repair-report-sha256 <sha256>       --phase-receipt /path/to/geometry-reprobe.json --phase-receipt-sha256 <sha256>       --report /tmp/q3d-phase-d.json       --scratch-root /tmp --device cuda:0 --allow-real-profile

This command retains the recipe's full 8,000-update T/J budgets and applies
the engine's update_limit=20 API separately to each measured stage. ``--stage
T`` can profile the teacher before T/Q/P artifacts exist; ``--stage J`` and
the default ``--stage all`` require exact completed T/Q/P artifacts. It never
runs Q/P or accepts synthetic gate overrides.
display_string_changes.after:
